name: phantom
description: Finds bugs while you type, in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, C, C++, Rust, Ruby and PHP: crashes and wrong answers, each backed by an input reproduced in a sandbox.

commands.title: Phantom: Choose Tier for a Layer

phantom.enabled.description: Analyse supported files while you type.

phantom.backendUrl.description: Address of the Phantom backend (python -m backend).

phantom.debounceMs.description: How long to wait after you stop typing before analysing.

phantom.shadowRun.description: Run each function on boundary inputs (and the model's suggestions) in the sandbox to find reproducible bugs.

phantom.useModel.description: Let Phantom's AI suggest extra inputs and rate risk (needs an AI key: "Phantom: Set AI Key"). Its inputs only count if they reproduce in the sandbox; without it, Phantom's own engine still finds and proves bugs.

enumDescriptions: Specter always; the Analyst when you open or save a file, or when an edit is risky
The Analyst too, on every pause: wrong answers and broken callers

phantom.startBackend.description: Start the Phantom backend automatically when it isn't running.

phantom.pythonPath.description: Python that runs the backend. Empty: the environment "Phantom: Set Up" created, else python3.

phantom.serverPath.description: Folder with Phantom's backend. Empty: the copy bundled with the extension.

phantom.tiers.specter.description: How deeply Specter (every pause in typing) thinks.

phantom.tiers.analyst.description: How deeply the Analyst thinks when it reads what your code is meant to do.

walkthroughs.title: Meet Phantom
walkthroughs.description: Phantom finds bugs while you write code, and proves each one by running it.

steps.title: Phantom is in your editor
steps.description:
Phantom watches the functions you change. When you pause typing, it runs them on inputs designed to break them, in a locked sandbox, and tells you only about failures it can replay.
[Open the Phantom panel](command:workbench.view.extension.phantom)

steps.title: Set up once
steps.description:
Phantom needs Docker for its sandboxes. Set Up installs its engine and the sandbox for each language.
[Run Set Up](command:phantom.setUp)

steps.title: Read a finding
steps.description: Red: fails on an input your types allow, or disagrees with its own example. Yellow: fails under an assumption, or gives a result the Analyst didn't expect. Faint dots: only on null. ▶ Replay runs the input again against your current code.

steps.title: Choose depth and tier
steps.description:
Specter checks every pause; the Analyst checks what your code is meant to do; the Oracle arrives in an update. Pick how deep each layer thinks.
[Choose depth and tiers](command:phantom.chooseDepth)

scripts.package: npm run compile && npm run bundle && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --skip-license
